title: CrownmarkCollections
description: Account-wide permanent collection buffs unlocked via historical crownmark sets inside the Citadel Codex museum.

collections.name: Founders of the Vanguard
collections.lore_citation: Volume I: The original armor pieces of Maegan Violet's direct bloodline, who stood at the spire's crown during the first Eclipse.

collections.name: Lunar Archon Vestiges
collections.lore_citation: Volume IV: Regalia of the high priestesses who maintained the silver crescent gates long before the dark corruption settled.

collections.name: Phantom Syndicate Armaments
collections.lore_citation: Volume VII: Stealth garments recovered from the deep ravines, belonging to the original seven Grandmasters of the Obsidian Syndicate.

collections.name: Iron & Alchemical Machinery
collections.lore_citation: Volume XI: Early blueprint prototypes of the brass, steel, and alchemical apparatuses that mechanized Crownspire's gold mines.

collections.name: Vow of the Voidwalkers
collections.lore_citation: Volume XV: Crownmarks touched by the dark rift void. Corrupted, yet highly essential for countering demonic incursions.
